Interface IApp

Namespace
Tuinet

Tuinet.dll

An app for Tuinet.Terminal.Run(Tuinet.IApp,System.Int32): it handles events and draws frames, and the loop decides when. Times are milliseconds since Tuinet.Terminal.Run(Tuinet.IApp,System.Int32) started.

public interface IApp

Methods

Handle(Event, long)

Update state for one event: input, a resize, a posted message, or Tuinet.EventKind.Tick when an animation frame or Tuinet.IApp.NextDueMs(System.Int64) comes due. Return false to stop the loop.

bool Handle(Event ev, long nowMs)

Parameters

ev Event
nowMs long

Returns

bool

IsAnimating(long)

True while something moves on its own (a spinner, a progress bar): the loop then draws at the frame rate, with a Tuinet.EventKind.Tick before each frame that no input caused. False sleeps until input.

bool IsAnimating(long nowMs)

Parameters

nowMs long

Returns

bool

NextDueMs(long)

When the app next needs a frame with no input (e.g. an Tuinet.Alarm's Tuinet.Alarm.DueMs to hide a message), or System.Int64.MaxValue for never. The loop wakes then with a Tuinet.EventKind.Tick; a time that stays in the past wakes it on every pass.

long NextDueMs(long nowMs)
